title: Skill Routing Graph Trigger Row
description: Schema for a single trigger row in docs/skill-routing-graph.md. Used by `vet check routing` to validate each table row. The markdown table is the source of truth; this schema constrains its columns.

symptom.description: Predictive or reactive symptom description, e.g. 'Redis slow query 5min +50%'.

primary.description: Primary skill that owns the diagnosis, e.g. ve-redis-ops.

secondary.description: Secondary skills to delegate to. May be empty.

action.description: Action taken after trigger, e.g. 'Pre-emptive MONITOR + index suggestion'.

source.description: predictive = triggered before alarm fires; reactive = triggered by alarm/ticket.
